svg.text: FastAPI on ECS Fargate with RDS PostgreSQL (Terraform)
Route 53 (global): A alias aethrclothes.shop + www to the ALB
HTTPS health check of /db-check every 30 s from 3 regions
ECS service: 2 to 6 tasks, autoscaling on CPU 60 %
GitHub Actions on push to main: build image, push to ECR, terraform apply, smoke test
OIDC, no AWS keys stored; Terraform state in S3 + DynamoDB lock (bootstrap stack)
Internet → ALB SG (80/443) → Tasks SG (8000) → DB SG (5432). Tasks egress only 443 (AWS APIs via NAT) and 5432. Dashed purple = AWS API / control traffic.
